format.quote: Cultures were mixed at ~200 rpm using PTFE magnetic stir bars in BG11 medium

caveat: Measured in an engineered sucrose-exporting PCC 7942 strain (cscB+ Δsps), not wild type and not UTEX 2973. The nine mixed co-culture samples (Se_Rt_CC, GSM9805358–GSM9805366), sequenced together with Rhodotorula toruloides, are not shipped. Each layer averages days 4, 6 and 8, which removes the time course; the eight pANS plasmid rows (HTX97_RS) have no UTEX counterpart.
